apps.name: UTM SE
apps.subtitle: Retro PC emulator
apps.localizedDescription:
UTM SE is a PC emulator that allows you to run classic software and old-school games.

• Supports both VGA mode for graphics and terminal mode for text-only operating systems
• Emulates x86, ARM, PPC, and RISC-V architectures
• Run pre-built machines or create your own configuration from scratch
• Built from QEMU, a powerful and widely used emulator

privacy.name: LocalNetwork
privacy.usageDescription: The virtual machine may access the local network. UTM also uses the local network to communicate with AltServer.

privacy.name: Microphone
privacy.usageDescription: Permission is required for any virtual machine to record from the microphone.

versions.localizedDescription:
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab (requires iOS 26).
* **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.
* **Drive management**: Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS 26.
* **Redesigned keyboard bar**: The keyboard accessory bar now matches the iOS 26 keyboard, and game controller Options and Home buttons can be mapped.
* The minimum supported version is now iOS 15.
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
